save_flax_file: save a flax jax.numpy dictionary to a safetensors file using save_file
load_flax_file: load a flax safetensors file into a dictionary of jax.numpy tensors using load_file
open_flax_safetensors: open a flax safetensors file with safe_open framework and iterate over tensors

test_flax_zero_sized_tensor: test saving and loading a flax safetensors file with zero-sized tensors
